# rill-ext

> Vendor extensions for the rill language runtime. Each extension is an independent npm package under `@rcrsr/`. Extensions in the same category share identical function signatures, so scripts swap providers without code changes. All packages require `@rcrsr/rill` as a peer dependency at matching minor version (e.g., extension `0.18.x` works with `rill@0.18.y`).

rill-ext is a pnpm monorepo containing 11 published extension packages and 3 private shared libraries. Extensions follow a factory pattern: call `create*Extension(config)` to get host functions and a `dispose()` cleanup function. The host registers these functions into a rill runtime context, and scripts access them via `use<ext:name>`.

Repository: https://github.com/rcrsr/rill-ext
Core runtime: https://github.com/rcrsr/rill
License: MIT

## Architecture

### Extension factory pattern

Every extension exports a factory function returning `{ value, dispose }`:

```typescript
import { p } from '@rcrsr/rill-ext-param-shared';

export function createAnthropicExtension(config: LLMProviderConfig): ExtensionFactoryResult {
  // validate config, create SDK client
  return {
    value: {
      message: toCallable({ fn, params: [p.str('text'), p.dict('options')] }),
      // ... more functions
    },
    dispose: async () => { /* cleanup */ },
  };
}
```

### Host integration

```typescript
import { createRuntimeContext, prefixFunctions } from '@rcrsr/rill';
import { createAnthropicExtension } from '@rcrsr/rill-ext-anthropic';

const ext = createAnthropicExtension({
  api_key: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
  model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
});
const { dispose, ...functions } = prefixFunctions('llm', ext);
const ctx = createRuntimeContext({ functions });
// execute scripts, then:
await dispose();
```

### rill-config.json declaration

Extensions are declared in `rill-config.json` for script-level use:

```json
{
  "extensions": {
    "mounts": { "llm": "@rcrsr/rill-ext-anthropic" },
    "config": {
      "llm": {
        "api_key": "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}",
        "model": "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Scripts load extensions with `use<ext:name>`:

```rill
use<ext:llm> => $ai
$ai.message("Hello")() => $result
$result.content -> log
```

### Error codes

- `RILL-R004`: Extension-level errors (validation, API, runtime)
- `RILL-R001`: Shared validation errors (converted to R004 by extensions)

### Streaming convention

Functions returning `RillStream` support two patterns:

```rill
# Iterate chunks incrementally
ext::fn("input") => $s
$s -> each { log }

# Resolve to result dict
ext::fn("input")() => $result
$result.content -> log
```

## LLM Extensions

Three LLM extensions share identical 6-function APIs. Swap providers by changing the mount. Scripts stay unchanged.

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-anthropic

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-anthropic`
SDK: `@anthropic-ai/sdk`
Factory: `createAnthropicExtension(config)`

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-openai

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-openai`
SDK: `openai`
Factory: `createOpenAIExtension(config)`

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-gemini

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-gemini`
SDK: `@google/genai`
Factory: `createGeminiExtension(config)`
Note: Google's API returns 0 for token counts and empty string for request IDs.

### LLM configuration (all three)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `api_key` | string | yes | API key |
| `model` | string | yes | Model identifier |
| `temperature` | number | no | Sampling temperature, 0.0-2.0 |
| `max_tokens` | number | no | Maximum response tokens (default: 4096) |
| `system` | string | no | Default system prompt |
| `embed_model` | string | no | Model for embed operations |
| `base_url` | string | no | Custom API endpoint |
| `max_retries` | number | no | Retry attempts on failure |
| `timeout` | number | no | Request timeout in ms |

### LLM functions (all three)

**message(text, options?) -> RillStream**

Single prompt. Stream yields text delta strings. Resolves to result dict.

```rill
use<ext:llm> => $ai
$ai.message("Explain TCP handshakes")() => $result
$result.content      # response text
$result.usage.input  # input tokens
$result.usage.output # output tokens
$result.stop_reason  # why generation stopped
$result.model        # model identifier
$result.id           # request identifier
$result.messages     # conversation history
```

**messages(messages, options?) -> RillStream**

Multi-turn conversation. Messages format: `[{ role, content }, ...]`. Same result dict as `message`.

```rill
[
  [role: "user", content: "What is rill?"],
  [role: "assistant", content: "A scripting language."],
  [role: "user", content: "Tell me more."],
] -> $ai.messages => $s
$s() => $result
$result.content   # latest response
$result.messages  # full conversation history
```

**embed(text) -> dict**

Text embedding. Requires `embed_model` in config.

```rill
$ai.embed("sample text") => $vec
$vec.dimensions  # vector size
$vec.model       # embedding model used
$vec.vector      # number array
```

**embed_batch(texts) -> dict**

Batch embeddings.

```rill
["first", "second"] -> $ai.embed_batch => $result
$result.len        # number of vectors
$result.succeeded  # successful count
$result.vectors    # array of vectors
```

**tool_loop(prompt, tools, options?) -> RillStream**

Agentic loop. The model calls rill closures as tools until it has an answer. Tools is a dict mapping `name -> callable`. Stream yields structured events.

```rill
^("Get weather") |^("City name") city: string| {
  "Weather in {$city}: 72F sunny"
} => $get_weather

$ai.tool_loop("What's the weather in Paris?", [
  get_weather: $get_weather,
], [max_turns: 5]) => $s

# Stream events
$s -> each {
  $.type    # "text_delta", "tool_call", or "tool_result"
  $.text    # available when type == "text_delta"
  $.name    # available when type == "tool_call" or "tool_result"
  $.args    # available when type == "tool_call"
  $.result  # available when type == "tool_result"
}

# Or resolve
$s() => $result
$result.content  # final response text
$result.turns    # number of LLM round-trips
$result.usage    # { input, output } token counts
```

Tool loop options:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `system` | string | config default | Override system prompt |
| `max_tokens` | number | config default | Override max tokens |
| `max_turns` | number | unlimited | Limit LLM round-trips |
| `max_errors` | number | 3 | Consecutive error limit |
| `messages` | list | [] | Prepend conversation history |

**generate(prompt, options) -> dict**

Structured output extraction. Returns parsed data matching a schema.

```rill
# Schema from dict descriptor
[name: "string", confidence: "number", tags: "list"] => $schema
$ai.generate("Extract metadata from: rill is a pipe-based language", [
  schema: $schema,
]) => $result
$result.data.name        # extracted field
$result.data.confidence  # extracted field
$result.raw              # original JSON string
$result.usage            # { input, output }
$result.stop_reason      # stop reason
$result.model            # model identifier

# Schema from closure structural type
|^("Name") name: string, ^(description: "Score") confidence: number| { } => $extractor
$ai.generate("Extract data", [schema: $extractor.^input]) => $result
```

Generate options:

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `schema` | dict or RillStructuralType | yes | Output schema definition |
| `system` | string | no | Override system prompt |
| `max_tokens` | number | no | Override max tokens |
| `messages` | list | no | Prepend conversation history |

### LLM events

Events use the provider prefix (`anthropic:`, `openai:`, `gemini:`):

| Event | Emitted when |
|-------|-------------|
| `{provider}:message` | message() completes |
| `{provider}:messages` | messages() completes |
| `{provider}:embed` | embed() completes |
| `{provider}:embed_batch` | embed_batch() completes |
| `{provider}:tool_loop` | tool_loop() completes |
| `{provider}:generate` | generate() completes |
| `{provider}:tool_call` | tool invoked during loop |
| `{provider}:tool_result` | tool returns during loop |
| `{provider}:error` | any operation fails |

Completion events include: `duration` (ms), `model`, `usage`, `request`, `content`.

## Key-Value Extensions

Two KV extensions share an identical 11-function API. Scripts swap backends without code changes.

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-kv-sqlite

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-kv-sqlite`
SDK: `better-sqlite3`
Factory: `createSqliteKvExtension(config)`

Config:

```json
{
  "mounts": {
    "user": {
      "mode": "read-write",
      "database": "./data/app.db",
      "table": "user_state",
      "schema": { "name": { "type": "string", "default": "" } },
      "maxEntries": 10000,
      "maxValueSize": 102400
    }
  },
  "maxStoreSize": 10485760,
  "writePolicy": "dispose"
}
```

SQLite mount parameters:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `mode` | string | yes | `'read'`, `'write'`, or `'read-write'` |
| `database` | string | yes | SQLite file path |
| `table` | string | yes | Table name |
| `schema` | Record | no | Field schema with type and default |
| `maxEntries` | number | no | Max entries per mount (default: 10000) |
| `maxValueSize` | number | no | Max value size in bytes (default: 102400) |

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-kv-redis

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-kv-redis`
SDK: `ioredis`
Factory: `createRedisKvExtension(config)`

Config:

```json
{
  "url": "redis://localhost:6379",
  "mounts": {
    "user": {
      "mode": "read-write",
      "prefix": "app:user:",
      "schema": { "name": { "type": "string", "default": "" } },
      "maxEntries": 10000,
      "maxValueSize": 102400
    }
  }
}
```

Redis mount parameters:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `mode` | string | yes | `'read'`, `'write'`, or `'read-write'` |
| `prefix` | string | yes | Redis key prefix |
| `schema` | Record | no | Field schema with type and default |
| `maxEntries` | number | no | Max entries per mount (default: 10000) |
| `maxValueSize` | number | no | Max value size in bytes (default: 102400) |

Additional top-level: `url` (string, required) - Redis connection URL.

### KV functions (both backends)

```rill
use<ext:kv> => $store
```

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `get` | mount, key | any | Get value or schema default |
| `get_or` | mount, key, default | any | Get value or provided default |
| `set` | mount, key, value | bool | Set value (validates against schema) |
| `merge` | mount, key, partial | bool | Merge dict fields into existing value |
| `delete` | mount, key | bool | Delete key |
| `keys` | mount | list | All keys in mount |
| `has` | mount, key | bool | Check key existence |
| `clear` | mount | bool | Clear all keys (restores schema defaults) |
| `getAll` | mount | dict | All entries as dict |
| `schema` | mount | list | Schema information |
| `mounts` | (none) | list | Available mount names |

```rill
$store.set("user", "name", "Alice")
$store.get("user", "name") => $name
$store.has("user", "name") => $exists
$store.keys("user") => $all_keys
$store.getAll("user") => $everything
$store.delete("user", "name")
$store.clear("user")
$store.mounts() => $mount_names
```

## Filesystem Extension

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-fs-s3

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-fs-s3`
SDK: `@aws-sdk/client-s3`
Factory: `createS3FsExtension(config)`
Supports: AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, and S3-compatible services.

Config:

```json
{
  "mounts": {
    "data": {
      "mode": "read-write",
      "region": "us-east-1",
      "bucket": "my-app-data",
      "prefix": "uploads/",
      "credentials": {
        "accessKeyId": "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}",
        "secretAccessKey": "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}"
      },
      "endpoint": "https://custom.endpoint.com",
      "forcePathStyle": false,
      "glob": "*.csv"
    }
  },
  "maxFileSize": 10485760,
  "encoding": "utf-8"
}
```

Mount parameters:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `mode` | string | yes | `'read-only'` or `'read-write'` |
| `region` | string | yes | AWS region or `'auto'` for R2 |
| `bucket` | string | yes | S3 bucket name |
| `prefix` | string | no | Object key prefix for namespace isolation |
| `credentials` | object | yes | `{ accessKeyId, secretAccessKey }` |
| `endpoint` | string | no | Custom endpoint for S3-compatible services |
| `forcePathStyle` | boolean | no | Path-style addressing (required for MinIO) |
| `glob` | string | no | File filter pattern |

### FS functions

All path arguments use `/mount/path` format. Longest mount name wins.

```rill
use<ext:fs> => $storage
```

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `read` | path | string | File contents |
| `write` | path, content | string | Bytes written |
| `append` | path, content | string | Bytes appended |
| `list` | path | list | Directory contents (non-recursive) |
| `find` | path, pattern? | list | Recursive file search with glob |
| `exists` | path | bool | File existence check |
| `remove` | path | bool | Delete file |
| `stat` | path | dict | `{ name, type, size, modified }` |
| `mkdir` | path | bool | Create directory (no-op for S3) |
| `copy` | src, dest | bool | Copy file (same mount only) |
| `move` | src, dest | bool | Move file (same mount only) |
| `mounts` | (none) | list | Mount metadata |

```rill
$storage.write("/data/out.txt", "hello")
$storage.read("/data/out.txt") => $content
$storage.exists("/data/out.txt") => $yes
$storage.stat("/data/out.txt") => $info
$storage.list("/data/") => $files
$storage.find("/data/", "*.csv") => $csvs
$storage.remove("/data/out.txt")
```

## Vector Database Extensions

Three vector DB extensions share an identical 11-function API. Scripts swap backends without code changes.

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-qdrant

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-qdrant`
SDK: `@qdrant/js-client-rest`
Factory: `createQdrantExtension(config)`

Config:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `url` | string | yes | Qdrant API endpoint URL |
| `collection` | string | yes | Default collection name |
| `dimensions` | number | no | Vector dimension size |
| `distance` | string | no | `"cosine"`, `"euclidean"`, or `"dot"` (default: cosine) |
| `apiKey` | string | no | API key for Qdrant Cloud |
| `timeout` | number | no | Request timeout in ms |

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-pinecone

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-pinecone`
SDK: `@pinecone-database/pinecone`
Factory: `createPineconeExtension(config)`

Config:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `apiKey` | string | yes | Pinecone API key |
| `index` | string | yes | Index name |
| `namespace` | string | no | Namespace (default: empty string) |
| `timeout` | number | no | Request timeout in ms (default: 30000) |

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-chroma

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-chroma`
SDK: `chromadb`
Factory: `createChromaExtension(config)`

Config:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `url` | string | no | ChromaDB endpoint (omit for embedded mode) |
| `collection` | string | yes | Default collection name |
| `embeddingFunction` | string | no | Embedding function name (e.g., 'openai') |
| `timeout` | number | no | Request timeout in ms |

### Vector DB functions (all three)

```rill
use<ext:qdrant> => $db
```

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `upsert` | id, vector, metadata? | dict | Insert or update vector |
| `upsert_batch` | items | dict | Batch insert (items: `[{ id, vector, metadata }]`) |
| `search` | vector, options? | dict | Similarity search |
| `get` | id | dict or null | Retrieve by ID |
| `delete` | id | dict | Remove vector |
| `delete_batch` | ids | dict | Batch remove |
| `count` | (none) | dict | Collection vector count |
| `create_collection` | name, options? | dict | Create collection |
| `delete_collection` | name | dict | Delete collection |
| `list_collections` | (none) | dict | List all collections |
| `describe` | (none) | dict | Collection info and stats |

Search options:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `limit` | number | 10 | Max results |
| `score_threshold` | number | none | Min similarity score |
| `filter` | dict | none | Metadata filter conditions |
| `offset` | number | 0 | Pagination offset |

```rill
$db.upsert("doc-1", [0.1, 0.2, 0.3], [title: "Example"])
$db.search([0.1, 0.2, 0.3], [limit: 5]) => $results
$db.get("doc-1") => $point
$db.delete("doc-1")
$db.count() => $n
$db.create_collection("new_coll", [dimensions: 384, distance: "cosine"])
$db.list_collections() => $colls
$db.describe() => $info
```

## MCP Extension

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-mcp

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-mcp`
SDK: `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`
Factory: `createMcpExtension(config)`

Connects rill scripts to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Supports stdio and HTTP transports. Auto-generates host functions from server metadata across three capability dicts: `tools`, `resources`, `prompts`.

Config:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `transport` | object | yes | Transport configuration |
| `timeout` | number | no | Request timeout in ms (default: 30000) |
| `toolFilter` | string[] | no | Include only named tools |
| `resourceFilter` | string[] | no | Include only named resource URIs |
| `promptFilter` | string[] | no | Include only named prompts |

Stdio transport:

```json
{
  "type": "stdio",
  "command": "npx",
  "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/tmp"],
  "env": { "LOG_LEVEL": "info" }
}
```

HTTP transport:

```json
{
  "type": "http",
  "url": "https://mcp.example.com/v1",
  "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer ${API_KEY}" }
}
```

### MCP value structure

```
ext:mcp
  .tools
    .read_file(path, ...)      # MCP tool
    .search_files(pattern, ...) # MCP tool
  .resources
    .read_resource(uri)         # reads any resource by URI
    .resource_app_log()         # static resource shortcut
  .prompts
    .code_review(code, ...)     # MCP prompt template
```

### MCP usage

```rill
use<ext:fs> => $fs
$fs.tools.read_file([path: "/tmp/test.txt"]) => $result
$result.content -> log
```

### MCP + LLM composition

Pass MCP tools directly to an LLM's `tool_loop`:

```rill
use<ext:fs> => $fs
use<ext:ai> => $ai

$ai.tool_loop("Find all TODOs in the project", $fs.tools, [
  max_turns: 10,
]) => $result
$result.content -> log
```

Combine tools from multiple MCP servers:

```rill
use<ext:fs> => $fs
use<ext:gh> => $gh
$fs.tools -> .merge($gh.tools) => $all_tools
$ai.tool_loop("Read README and create issues", $all_tools)
```

## Claude Code Extension

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-claude-code

npm: `@rcrsr/rill-ext-claude-code`
SDK: `which`, peer dep `node-pty`
Factory: `createClaudeCodeExtension(config)`

Spawns the Claude Code CLI as a subprocess. Scripts send prompts, invoke skills, and run commands. All 3 functions return `RillStream`.

Prerequisites: `node-pty` (native compilation) and `claude` binary in `$PATH`.

Config:

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `binaryPath` | string | `'claude'` | Path to Claude CLI binary |
| `defaultTimeout` | number | 1800000 | Timeout in ms (max: 3600000) |
| `dangerouslySkipPermissions` | boolean | true | Skip permission checks |
| `settingSources` | string | `''` | Settings to load: `''`, `'user'`, `'project'`, `'user,project'` |

### Claude Code functions

**prompt(text, options?) -> RillStream**

```rill
use<ext:claude_code> => $cc
$cc.prompt("Explain TCP handshakes")() => $result
$result.result       # response text
$result.tokens       # { prompt, cacheWrite5m, cacheWrite1h, cacheRead, output }
$result.cost         # cost in USD
$result.exitCode     # CLI exit code (0 = success)
$result.duration     # execution time in ms
```

**skill(name, args?) -> RillStream**

```rill
$cc.skill("commit", [message: "fix: resolve timeout bug"])() => $result
```

**command(name, args?) -> RillStream**

```rill
$cc.command("review-pr", [pr: "123"])() => $result
```

Per-call option: `timeout` (number) overrides `defaultTimeout`.

### Claude Code events

| Event | Emitted when |
|-------|-------------|
| `claude-code:prompt` | prompt completes |
| `claude-code:skill` | skill completes |
| `claude-code:command` | command completes |
| `claude-code:error` | any operation fails |

## Shared Packages

Internal packages bundled into consuming extensions at build time. Not published to npm.

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-param-shared

Parameter builder helpers for `RillParam` objects. All extensions depend on this.

```typescript
import { p } from '@rcrsr/rill-ext-param-shared';

p.str('name', 'description')           // string param
p.num('name', 'description', default)  // number param
p.bool('name', 'description', default) // boolean param
p.dict('name', 'description', default, fields) // dict param with optional structural fields
p.list('name', itemType, 'description')  // list param
p.callable('name', 'description')       // closure param
```

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-llm-shared

Shared validation, error handling, tool loop orchestration, and JSON Schema building. All 3 LLM extensions depend on this.

Exports: `validateApiKey`, `validateModel`, `validateTemperature`, `validateMessages`, `validateEmbedText`, `validateEmbedBatch`, `validateEmbedModel`, `mapProviderError`, `executeToolLoop`, `buildResponseMessages`, `buildJsonSchema`, `buildJsonSchemaFromStructuralType`, `mapRillType`.

Key types: `LLMExtensionConfig`, `LLMProviderConfig`, `ProviderErrorDetector`, `ToolLoopCallbacks`, `ToolLoopResult`, `ToolLoopChunk`.

### @rcrsr/rill-ext-vector-shared

Common utilities for all 3 vector DB extensions.

Exports: `mapVectorError`, `withEventEmission`, `executeBatch`, `createDisposalState`, `checkDisposed`, `dispose`, `assertRequired`, `createFunctionWrapper`, `normalizeDistance`, `vectorParam`.

Key types: `VectorExtensionConfig`, `BatchResult`, `DisposalState`, `DistanceMetric`.
